open_gaps: One band row was DELETED on 2026-09-24: Iowa State University, out_of_state, 'Academic Achievement Award', GPA 3.00-3.09. The school's own page prints '--' in that cell -- the award pays nothing at that GPA -- and the schema has no zero (college_automatic_award_bands_award_positive_check) and refuses a band with neither a figure nor words. A student at that GPA still receives Iowa State's separate $2,000/year Expedition Award, which this corpus does not hold for any GPA level; that is an unfilled gap, not a contradiction.

29 band rows carried an open-ended score bound ('29+ ACT', '<=20 ACT', 'SAT of 1300 or above') stored as an EMPTY score_low or score_high, which the landed CHECK college_automatic_award_bands_score_iff_test_check refuses. They were closed on 2026-09-24 at the test's own published scale -- PublishedScoreScale.ACT_COMPOSITE = 1..36 and PublishedScoreScale.SAT_COMPOSITE = 400..1600, the repo's own landed constants -- and the two open ends were confirmed against the publishers' pages the same day (Kansas State's '<=20 ACT, <=1030 SAT' column and Northern State's 'SAT of 1300 or above' row).

Three urls answered 403 to bin/check-link in BOTH passes and are committed as 'unknown' WITH the date we asked, which is the legal and honest state: finaid.umich.edu (Michigan) and the two go.okstate.edu freshman-scholarship pages. Their award rows are unchanged; the pages were read by the curation passes.

Two award rows are classified gpa_only_grid but carry score-bearing bands, and the classification is the thing to re-read, not the bands: University of Missouri-Columbia in_state (Perfect Score Scholarship, 36 ACT / 1570-1600 SAT) and University of Nebraska-Lincoln in_state (President's Scholarship at 36 ACT, Regents Scholar Tuition Commitment at 32 ACT). At both schools the bulk of the grid pays on GPA alone and the TOP award is score-gated, which is a shape award_kind cannot express with one value.
Two UAB rows publish a last-considered sitting that differs by test (February ACT / March SAT). They carry the school's words and no parsed date, by design: see the DDL's stated promotion trigger.
refresh_instruction: Re-read each school's own page, edit db/seed/automatic-awards/awards.csv and bands.csv, and re-run the loader. Never edit a landed row's meaning without a new checked_on: a correction is a re-read. Re-verify the urls with `nix develop -c bin/check-link -f <url list>` twice (HEAD, then -g for GET) and map the pair the way bin/cds-link-sweep does: 2xx in either pass is found, 404/410 in BOTH is not_found, anything else is unknown WITH the date. The build fails 90 days before expires_on (HandTypedReferenceData.REFRESH_LEAD).

cited_documents_without_an_award_row.why: ACT's own Composite-arithmetic rule, cited by the ACT combination (RFC 239, D-H). Fetched 2026-09-24, HTTP 200. It carries BOTH sentences the service needs: "Your Composite score is the average of your English, math, and reading scores, rounded to the nearest whole number." and "Fractions less than one-half are rounded down; fractions one-half or more are rounded up." ACT's higher-education page (…/the-act-postsecondary-professionals/scores.html) still prints the pre-2025 four-subject rule and is deliberately NOT cited.

the University of Nebraska-Lincoln page that states the Regents Scholar Tuition Commitment's award in the school's own words and its 32 ACT floor. The award row for unit_id 181464 in_state cites the President's Scholarship page, which does not describe this second award.

corrections.what: award_kind corrected from gpa_only_grid to score_grid
corrections.why: The first classification counted a band as score-gated only when it carried a per-year DOLLAR figure. Missouri's Perfect Score and Nebraska's President's and Regents awards are score-gated at the apex and publish a KIND of award rather than an amount, so they were mis-filed as GPA-only. Saying a score changes nothing at those schools would be false for their top band.
